summary: Peabody Energy Corp (issuer) filed an 8-K announcing its intention to offer $225M aggregate principal amount of Convertible Senior Notes due 2031 (plus an initial purchasers' option for up to an additional $25M) in a private Rule 144A offering. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, semi-annual interest, maturing June 1, 2031, convertible into cash and/or stock at Peabody's election. No board recommendation or advisor named; this is a standard capital markets transaction, not a special situation. What to watch: pricing terms and conversion premium, but no risk-arb angle.
